YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people‑centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

About the Role:

We currently have 90+ Data team members who create and maintain our data products and we are looking to further expand the team to continue to increase our product portfolio. Those with strong analytical skills are encouraged to apply.

At YipitData, we value ownership and impact. While nearly everyone enters the Data Specialist position at the same level, starting compensation is based on years of relevant experience. Our career ladder also rewards strong performance with frequent opportunities to grow compensation and achieve promotions.

See this short video to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current Data Specialists love working here!

In this role, you will:

  • Be the primary owner of high-impact work such as running or building new data products end‑to‑end, running centralized data ingestion pipelines that the broader Data team relies on, or building clean granular data feeds that help clients dive into data.
  • Work with massive amounts of data to help answer our clients’ key questions about the companies we cover and the datasets we analyze. You will learn about our proprietary methods and techniques to ensure data accuracy and derive key insights.
  • Become a trusted and reliable resource for our internal stakeholders or clients and work with them to identify and answer their key questions. You’ll gain insight into how investors use data in their investment decisions by contributing to data feeds, custom analysis, or data reports that are consumed by the top investors in the world. If you join one of our Central Data teams, you’ll also learn how our data drives decision‑making at some of the largest companies in the world.
  • Improve our products, data pipelines, or data feeds by developing entirely new methodologies and features for our products, exploring and scaling use across the data team of new third‑party datasets, or creating new modules to make our raw feeds data experience better. We value self‑improvement and experimentation and expect you to enhance the products, pipelines, or data feeds that you own.
  • Learn or sharpen existing SQL and Python skills starting with our two‑month new hire training program that will teach you SQL, PySpark, and Python fundamentals as well as our internal tools and processes.

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have a strong ownership mentality and want to ensure our products are the best in the world
  • You have strong attention to detail
  • You are a methodical problem‑solver
  • You can clearly communicate complex concepts, both orally and in writing
  • You strive to make tasks as efficient as possible
  • You have an ability to manage multiple priorities
  • You are experimental and curious – you aren’t afraid of changing the status quo
  • You are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company

What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long‑term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote‑first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self‑improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.

For You:

  • You’ll work with a New York‑based team
  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work

Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia/Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal‑opportunity employer.

Descrição da vaga

What is our company?

Lead Generation Hub (LGH) connects top-tier talent with growing U.S. companies by helping them build a high-quality pipeline. Our clients come to us because they need consistent, qualified meetings, and they stay because our process is intelligent, results-driven, and without any BS. What sets LGH apart is our selective, performance-based network. Everyone who joins us is rigorously evaluated through interviews and practical tests that measure real outbound ability, not only theory and whatever is on your resume. We care about what you can actually do. If you don’t meet every requirement but truly believe you can perform at a high level, apply and reach out to us. We value grit, ownership, and confidence.

What will you be doing as a BDR at LGH?

You’ll work remotely as a full-time or part-time Business Development Representative for US companies. That means you won’t be prospecting for LGH itself, but for our clients. Your day-to-day will focus on identifying, prospecting, and engaging potential clients, qualifying leads, and scheduling meetings with decision-makers, all through outbound outreach. Cold calling is at the heart of our methodology, supported by social and email outreach. You’ll also run weekly pipeline reviews with clients to ensure alignment and progress. All the tools, training, and methodology will be provided. At the same time, we encourage you to bring your own experience, tactics, and learned strategies to do your job and improve the process.

Qualifications

  • Advanced English. You’ll be cold-calling and selling in English every day.
  • You must have experience cold calling prospects outside of Brazil/LATAM, preferably to US companies.
  • Proficiency in B2B outbound lead generation techniques, with a results-oriented mindset.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment, with good time management skills.
  • Strong research and analytical skills for identifying and qualifying high-value leads.
  • Proficiency with CRM software and lead management tools.
  • Nice-to-have: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is advantageous.

Core Qualifications

  • Can you walk into a bar or social event and talk to anyone while enjoying it?
  • Can you handle rejection all day and still pick up the phone with energy on the next call?
  • Can you sit in front of your computer and make calls, one after another, for hours?

Interview Steps

  1. Interview with a recruiter at LGH
  2. Panel interview with LGH leadership
  3. Speak to a sales psychologist (if necessary)
  4. Take a PAID practical assessment. – This isn’t a simulation. You’ll have a few hours to build a live pipeline for a real LGH client. The session is paid ($7.00 USD/hour), and for most candidates, it lasts around 2 hours.
  5. Final Evaluation. Only candidates who pass every stage are invited into the LGH elite network. Once you’re in, we build your sales-focused resume and represent you to our U.S. clients to help ensure a consistent stream of work and income.

title: JavaScript Engineer — 3D Web Developer
description:
Who We Are Seeking

We seek a talented and experienced Full-Stack JavaScript Developer with 3D experience to join our international team. This role presents an excellent opportunity for those looking to work in a dynamic environment and be part of a high-performing international team, offering ample opportunities for growth and development in technical and interpersonal skills. We seek an energetic, driven, and articulate team player who is truly passionate about their work.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Architecture & Hands-on Development: Technical design and delivery of new features across the TypeScript codebase (React/Next.js and Node.js).
  • Core 3D Configurator: Architecting a high-performance web scene (Three.js/Babylon.js) to load, display, and interact with models for non-technical users and support higher-precision editing such as decals, placement, and transforms for experienced users.
  • Sticker: Implementing feature where users are able to drop, rotate, reposition, and scale stickers/images seamlessly across curved model surfaces.
  • Real-time Texture Painting (Pen & Brush): Creating a “Pen & Brush” tool that allows users to freehand draw directly onto the 3D garment and dynamic UV mapping.
  • Text Manipulation Tools: Building a feature to generate dynamic text (with custom fonts and styling), rasterize it, and project it onto the models as a texture layer.
  • UV Mapping Logic: Handling complex UV wrapping issues to ensure textures, drawings, and patterns wrap around seams and folds naturally without distortion.
  • Asset Ingestion: Build robust logic to support the ingestion of GLB and FBX assets with embedded textures.

Essential Qualifications

  • Expert JavaScript/TypeScript: 5+ years of software development experience with strong proficiency in modern ES6+ syntax.
  • 3D Web Libraries: Extensive commercial experience with Three.js , React Three Fiber (R3F) , or Babylon.js.
  • Graphics Math & Geometry: Solid understanding of Linear Algebra (Vectors, Matrices) and Raycasting logic required for the “Sticker”, “Material” and “Painting” tools.
  • Strong professional experience with Firebase (Firestore, Cloud Functions, Authentication, Hosting, and Storage).
  • Understanding of web application architecture, REST APIs, and client–server communication.
  • Experience with version control systems (Git) and collaborative development workflows.
  • Good understanding of UI/UX principles, responsive design, and cross-browser compatibility.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Excellent English verbal and written.

Who We Are:

DevGrid is a top-tier software consulting company based in the UK, with a development hub in Brazil and operations spanning Europe and the US. We believe that world-class software can only be created by a motivated and enthusiastic team in an environment that fosters creativity and free thinking. Established in 2015, our mission is to drive innovation and digital transformation by combining our robust business culture and exceptional engineers with forward-thinking business insights.

All DevGrid positions are open to individuals from all backgrounds (including all races, colors, nationalities, religions, genders, sexual orientations, disabilities, ages, or other applicable characteristics), promoting equal opportunities and affirmative action.

title: Wireless Architect
description:
Job Title: Wireless Domain Architect (Arista focused) Location: Brazil (Must be located in Brazil) Role: 90 Day Contract to Hire (Potential to convert from Contract to Full Time Employee with benefits)

Position Overview

The Wireless Domain Architect is a senior, hands‑on technical leadership role within a professional IT services organization, serving as the technical authority for enterprise wireless architecture.

This position demands expertise in Arista’s next‑generation wireless platforms, with demonstrable experience designing, deploying, and supporting Arista Cognitive Wi‑Fi and CloudVision Cognitive Unified Edge (CV‑CUE) solutions. The role blends solution design, field deployment leadership, pre‑sales technical scoping, and escalation support, operating as both an architect and hands‑on technical mentor to delivery teams.

Core Responsibilities

  • Wireless Architecture & Design: Serve as the primary wireless domain expert, with deep, hands‑on experience in Arista Wireless architecture, hardware, and cloud‑managed technologies. Design enterprise‑grade wireless solutions leveraging Arista’s cognitive networking capabilities, including: CloudVision Cognitive Unified Edge (CV‑CUE) centralized management, orchestration, and AI/ML‑driven automation planes; Cognitive Wi‑Fi platforms that provide data‑driven telemetry, real‑time analytics, and automatic optimization of wireless connections as network conditions evolve; Multi‑radio, multifunction AP deployments with support for cutting‑edge standards such as Wi‑Fi 6E and Wi‑Fi 7, zero‑touch onboarding, and high‑density coverage models. Develop high‑level and low‑level wireless designs (HLDs/LLDs) incorporating RF design, capacity planning, AP placement, and cognitive tuning mechanisms; Zero Trust and WIPS security configurations integrated with cloud orchestration; Flexible data path options and scalable control‑plane architectures inherent to CloudVision’s cognitive approach.
  • Deployment Leadership & Technical Execution: Lead and direct wireless deployment efforts in customer environments and ensure alignment to Arista cognitive design principles. Mentor and guide junior engineers through zero‑touch provisioning and onboarding of Arista AP platforms via CV‑CUE; Implementation of AI/ML‑enabled analytics and automated remediation features; Integration of AP connectivity with hosted identity management and external NAC solutions. Validate configurations and deployments to ensure stable, optimized performance across cognitive AP platforms and centralized CloudVision management.
  • Pre‑Sales Scoping & Technical Support: Participate in pre‑sales scoping calls with sales and delivery leadership. Provide detailed input on the effort required to transition customers from legacy Wi‑Fi environments to Arista, Cisco, Aruba and other OEM's or managed architectures; Level of Effort (LOE) estimation for discovery, design, deployment, optimization, and cutover phases; Validate technical assumptions for proposals and SOWs based on real experience with Arista cloud‑native wireless technologies.
  • Escalation & Customer Assurance: Serve as the escalation point for delivery issues related to Wi‑Fi behavior under load and real‑world spectrum conditions; Automation orchestration failures or troubleshooting of AI/ML‑driven recommendations; Cross‑domain issues spanning wired/wireless convergence and identity enforcement. Engage directly in customer escalation calls to remediate issues, restore confidence, and guide recovery.

Required Technical Expertise (Priority Order)

  • Arista Wireless – REQUIRED / NON-NEGOTIABLE: Hands‑on design, deployment, and operational experience with Arista Cognitive Wi‑Fi access point platforms (Wi‑Fi 6/6E/7) and CloudVision Cognitive Unified Edge (CV‑CUE) centralized management and cognitive analytics, AI/ML‑driven automation, telemetry, and troubleshooting inherent to Arista cognitive networking.
  • HPE Aruba Wireless Enterprise: Wireless design and deployment experience.
  • Juniper Wireless: Familiarity with Juniper Mist and related wireless platforms.
  • Cisco Wireless: Experience with Cisco enterprise wireless architectures.
  • Nile Wireless: Exposure to or hands‑on experience with Nile wireless solutions.

Required Qualifications

  • Track record of enterprise wireless design and deployment, with at least the majority of experience on Arista cognitive wireless solutions.
  • Demonstrable ability to lead design and delivery teams and mentor engineers in real time.
  • Communication skills to interact confidently with technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Ability to balance design, deployment, and escalation responsibilities simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in IT professional services or consulting.
  • Multi‑vendor wireless migration expertise.
  • Wireless certifications, particularly with Arista technologies.
  • Experience developing technical scoping documentation, proposals, and LOE estimates.

Role Characteristics

  • Combination of technical leadership, hands‑on execution, pre‑sales engagement, and post‑deployment escalation support.
  • Acts as the architectural authority for Arista wireless engagements.
  • Expected to deliver high‑quality outcomes while transferring knowledge to delivery teams.

title: Senior Product Experience Designer (Remote) - B2B Healthtech SaaS
description:
• Ongoing contract role · 10 hours per week · Remote (Brazil Based)
  • Flexible hours · PST time zone overlap preferred
  • International team across Brazil and North America
  • 5+ years of designing SaaS web applications (required)
  • Hands-on product experience design - workflows, flows, wireframes
  • Fluent English required - written and spoken

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Experience Designer to help shape the user experience of a SaaS web application platform that supports healthcare practitioners in delivering better patient outcomes.

This role is intentionally scoped at 10 hours per week , with some overlap during PST business hours required. It’s focused on senior-level product experience design - the kind of work where judgment, clarity, and good decisions matter.

This role is well suited to someone who:

  • enjoys focused, high-impact work,
  • may already have other professional commitments,
  • and values collaborating with a small, international team on meaningful product problems.

You’ll work closely with the founder and an experienced product, design, and development team to design end-to-end product experiences — from early concepts through to wireframes ready for visual design and implementation.

This is not a UI-polish role, and it’s not advisory. You will be designing the product experience itself.

About Optive

We build software that helps functional medicine and healthcare practitioners deliver better patient outcomes through clearer data, better insight, and more consistent follow-up care. Optive is the next stage of this work - a patient engagement and care platform designed to support ongoing, relationship-based healthcare rather than one-off interactions.

Our team works across two closely related platforms:

  • Optive - a patient engagement and care platform
  • Optimal DX - an established diagnostics and lab interpretation system used by practitioners today

You’ll contribute experience design work across both platforms , helping ensure coherence and clarity as the ecosystem evolves.

Our team is fully remote and international, working across Brazil and North America, with collaboration primarily across PST time zones - often a good fit for Brazil-based team members who prefer some evening overlap.

What You'll Do

  • Design end-to-end user journeys for complex SaaS web applications
  • Translate product goals into clear workflows, flows, and wireframes
  • Think through user intent, edge cases, and complexity vs. simplicity trade-offs
  • Create low-fidelity wireframes and experience diagrams (Figma, Miro, etc.)
  • Collaborate with a senior visual designer who will take your work into high-fidelity design
  • Challenge assumptions constructively and improve product clarity early - before development begins
  • Communicate clearly with an international team in English , both written and spoken

Why this Role Might be a Fit

  • Have 5+ years of experience designing customer-facing SaaS products or complex web applications
  • Have worked on products that real customers use in production
  • Are comfortable designing multi-step workflows and role-based experiences
  • Understand how UX decisions impact usability, adoption, and real-world outcomes
  • Prefer focused, senior-level contribution over full-time availability
  • Are comfortable working independently with a high level of trust
  • Can overlap some working hours with PST
  • Communicate fluently in English

Preferred Background

While we care far more about what you’ve designed and shipped than your exact job title, this role is best suited to someone who has:

  • Designed complex SaaS or web applications used in production
  • Owned or heavily influenced end-to-end product experiences , not just individual screens
  • Worked closely with founders, product leaders, or engineering teams in small to mid-sized software companies
  • Designed workflows where clarity, trust, and correctness matter (e.g. healthcare, fintech, B2B, or data-heavy products)
  • Been accountable for experience decisions that had real user and business impact

If your experience is primarily marketing sites, brand work, or UI-only execution, this role is unlikely to be a fit.

Proof Matters

We strongly prefer candidates who can show real work, such as:

  • Screenshots of shipped SaaS products
  • Annotated flows or wireframes
  • Case studies explaining experience design decisions
  • Clear examples of problems you personally solved

We understand NDAs exist — but we’re looking for people who can point to real experience design work and talk concretely about the decisions behind it.

How to Apply

Apply via .

Please include:

  • A short note about your experience designing SaaS or web applications
  • Links to relevant work (portfolio, screenshots, case studies)
  • Anything that clearly shows how you shaped the product experience

Applications without clear experience in SaaS or web-based product design will not be considered.

Vaga para o time de Baterias.

Buscamos pessoas que assim como a gente, sejam inovadoras, práticas, objetivas, tenham paixão pelo que fazem e visem a excelência. Então, você se encaixa neste perfil?

  • Inspecionar estabelecimentos industriais, boas áreas administrativas, avaliando riscos de incêndio, explosão, atmosferas perigosas ou outros eventos críticos, propondomia de medidas preventivas e corretivas conforme legislação vigente ou boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Atuar na elaboração, análise e avaliação de projetos de prevenção e combate a incêndio, incluindo sistemas de detecção, alarme, hidrantes, sprinklers, iluminação e sinalização de emergência, rotas de fuga e compartimentação, acompanhando sua implantação e testes operacionais;
  • Interagir tecnicamente como Corpo de Bombeiros, órgãos licenciadores e demais entidades reguladoras, acompanhando processos de aprovação, vistorias, emissão e renovação de AVCB/ACPe e demais licenças relacionadas à segurança contra incêndio;
  • Indicar, especificar, validar equipamentos de segurança coletiva e individual, com ênfase em proteção contra incêndio e emergência (EPCs, EPIs, sistemas fixos e móveis de combate a incêndio);
  • Planejar, coordenar e executar simulados de emergência, incluindo cenários de incêndio, explosão, vazamento de produtos perigosos ou abandono de área, avaliando tempos de resposta, rotas de fuga, ação da brigada de incêndio e eficácia dos sistemas de proteção, bem como elaborando relatórios críticos e planos de melhoria;

  • Conhecimento sólido das Normas Regulamentadoras;
  • Domínio de normas técnicas aplicáveis à proteção contra incêndio, como ABNT (NBR9077, NBR16820, NBR13714, NBR10897, NBR17240), além de regulamentos do Corpo de Bombeiros;

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O seu desafio como Senior AI Engineer :

Você será o pilar de engenharia da Tribo de Dados & IA. Sua missão vai muito além de codar : esperamos que você transforme protótipos de IA em produtos de software robustos, escaláveis e observáveis. Você será a referência técnica para garantir que nossas soluções (como assistentes jurídicos e sistemas de extração de dados) funcionem em produção com alta disponibilidade.

Suas principais responsabilidades :

Engenharia de Sistemas de IA (AI Engineering) :

Arquitetar e desenvolver o backend de aplicações baseadas em LLMs, garantindo que elas sejam rápidas, custo-eficientes e confiáveis.

Implementar pipelines de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) de ponta a ponta, cuidando desde a ingestão e chunking inteligente de dados até a estratégia de recuperação e geração de resposta.

Criar e manter Agentes Autônomos que realizam tarefas complexas, garantindo que tenham mecanismos de controle, memória e tratamento de erros (para evitar loops infinitos ou alucinações).

Liderança Técnica “Hands-on” :

Atuar como Tech Lead natural da squad : liderar definições de arquitetura, conduzir Code Reviews rigorosos (focados em design patterns e performance) e elevar a barra técnica do time.

Mentorar engenheiros plenos e juniores através de pair programming e discussões técnicas, ajudando a desbloquear problemas complexos do dia a dia.

Excelência Operacional & Cloud (AWS) :

Assumir a propriedade da infraestrutura das suas aplicações (“You build it, you run it”). Isso inclui saber arquitetar soluções na AWS e otimizar custos de inferência.

Garantir a observabilidade total dos sistemas : implementar logs estruturados, métricas e tracing (para debugar cadeias de LangChain / agentes em produção).

Automação Inteligente :

Desenvolver crawlers e bots robustos para captura de dados em larga escala, integrando essas automações diretamente com nossos pipelines de IA para enriquecimento de dados em tempo real.

Colaboração e Produto :

Trabalhar lado a lado com Product Managers e Designers para traduzir problemas de negócio vagos em soluções técnicas viáveis.

Ter a autonomia para questionar requisitos, propor simplificações e defender a qualidade do software contra prazos irrealistas (negociando débito técnico de forma consciente).

Requisitos e qualificações

O que buscamos (Hard Skills & Ferramentas) :

Para essa cadeira, buscamos um perfil de Engenharia de Software (Backend) com especialização em IA Generativa. Não procuramos apenas quem “consome APIs”, mas quem constrói sistemas resilientes ao redor delas.

Python Moderno & Engenharia Robusta :

Proficiência avançada em Python.

Domínio de Pydantic para validação de dados e FastAPI para construção de APIs assíncronas de alto desempenho.

Experiência com gerenciamento profissional de pacotes (Poetry ou uv) e ferramentas de qualidade de código.

Arquitetura de IA Generativa & Agentes :

Experiência sólida na construção de fluxos de IA com LangChain e, preferencialmente, orquestração de estado com LangGraph.

Capacidade de desenhar e implementar arquiteturas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) que vão além do básico : conhecimento prático de Hybrid Search (Vetorial + Keyword) e estratégias de Reranking (ex : Cohere, BGE) para garantir precisão.

Engenharia de Software & Cloud (AWS) :

Mentalidade de “You build it, you run it”. Experiência provisionando e mantendo infraestrutura em AWS (ECS, Lambda, SQS).

Domínio de Docker e familiaridade com Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform ou CDK).

Design de sistemas distribuídos e orientados a eventos (Event-driven), essenciais para lidar com fluxos de agentes assíncronos.

Automação & Extração de Dados :

Experiência com frameworks de automação de browser (foco em Playwright Async) para tarefas complexas de extração de dados e interação com sistemas legados.

Qualificação Necessária :

Metodologia : Vivência real em ambientes ágeis (Scrum / Kanban) com foco em entrega contínua.

Diferenciais (O que faz seus olhos brilharem) :

Se você tiver estes conhecimentos, você estará um passo à frente para liderar nossas iniciativas mais ambiciosas :

Sistemas Multi-Agentes (MAS) : Experiência prática construindo sistemas onde múltiplos agentes colaboram autonomamente. Familiaridade com Google ADK ou padrões agênticos como ReAct , Plan-and-Execute e loops de auto-correção ( Reflection ).

RAG de Próxima Geração : Conhecimento ou interesse em GraphRAG (uso de Knowledge Graphs para capturar relacionamentos complexos) e Self-RAG (agentes que avaliam a própria recuperação).

Otimização de LLMs & SLMs :

Experiência rodando modelos locais (Phi-3, Llama-3, Gemma) para otimização de custos.

Uso de DSPy para otimização programática de prompts (substituindo a engenharia de prompt manual).

Sobre as Lojas Guaibim:

Com DNA 100% baiano , somos uma empresa nascida em Valença, interior da Bahia, especializada em Varejo de Eletrodomésticos, Eletrônicos, Telefonia Celular, Móveis, Ar Condicionado, Ventilação e Utilidades para o Lar.

Em 20 de março de 1982 iniciamos a nossa caminhada com a abertura da primeira loja em Valença . Depois de 14 anos abrimos mais uma loja em Ituberá, e foi em 2003 que de forma mais intensa, ampliamos nossa rede, a partir da nova loja de Gandú. De lá para cá crescemos ano a ano de forma consistente e sustentável.

Hoje já passamos de 60 canais de venda , entre o interior e a capital Salvador, em alguns bairros e nos principais Shoppings, além das vendas online através de site próprio e marketplaces, entregando para todo o Brasil , com uma frota própria de 25 caminhões, parceria com grandes transportadoras e o Centro de Distribuição que é um dos mais modernos da Bahia com mais de 30 mil metros quadrados.

Desde o início sempre nos preocupamos com o que o nosso cliente precisava para realizar o sonho da sua casa mobiliada . Pensando nisso, proporcionamos acesso ao crédito, já naquela época, para a compra de móveis e eletrodomésticos, o que além de facilitar aos nossos clientes se unindo a preocupação com o melhor atendimento, foi o motivo da nossa consolidação.

O nosso Crediário se tornou referência e é o mais barato da Bahia (o que temos muito orgulho). Além disso disponibilizamos o maior parcelamento em até 18 vezes em todos os cartões , preservando o nosso compromisso de entregar facilidade, a você, nosso cliente.

Sobre a Casa + Fácil:

Com mais de 45 anos de atuação no mercado e DNA 100% baiano , a Casa+Fácil conquistou seu espaço e expandiu no mercado de materiais de construção sendo hoje a maior rede deste segmento na Bahia.

Ao longo dos anos aprendemos que mais difícil do que alcançar a excelência é mantê-la. Por isso, entendemos que nosso objetivo não é conquistar o sucesso, isso é uma consequência de nosso esforço diário. O que colocamos em primeiro lugar sempre é possibilitar e auxiliar na realização dos sonhos e conquistas dos nossos clientes, que são o centro do nosso negócio.

Tudo começou em 13 de agosto de 1972 com uma pequena loja chamada Casa do Fazendeiro , onde comercializávamos produtos para as fazendas na região de Valença - BA.

No ano de 1985 decidimos embarcar em um novo desafio: A venda de materiais para construção. Graças a confiança depositada por nossos fiéis clientes, ampliamos nossa rede e novas filiais foram fundadas.

Em 13 de Novembro de 2000 , passamos a nos chamar Casa & Fazenda , encarando novos desafios, oferecendo aos nossos clientes os melhores produtos e as melhores marcas do mercado, garantindo o nosso crescimento e a satisfação de todas as famílias que sempre confiaram no nosso trabalho.

Com o tempo construímos sonhos de milhares de pessoas, e a identidade de loja que facilita crédito para todos se fortaleceu. Desta forma, nós não tivemos medo de arriscar mais uma vez e em 01 de Abril de 2012 nos reinventamos como Casa+Fácil , trazendo um novo conceito e novas estratégias.

VEM SER GIGANTE, VEM TRABALHAR NA REDE DE FARMÁCIAS QUE É DO TAMANHO DO BRASIL

Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma, saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza! Nossa história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE e por meio da valorização humana, da superação de resultados, do foco no cliente, da sustentabilidade, da integridade e da inovação em soluções nos tornamos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil. Nosso modelo de negócios é baseado na venda de produtos e serviços voltados para a saúde e bem-estar dos nossos clientes. Atuamos no mercado de varejo de especialidade, seguindo o conceito de drugstore. Buscamos ser não somente uma rede de farmácias, mas um hub integrado de saúde. Desta forma, implementamos, a partir de 2016, o Clinic Farma, consultório farmacêutico o qual nossos clientes recebem, em salas equipadas e confortáveis, acompanhamento individualizado em seus tratamentos. Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente.

Se você tem amor por servir e é gente que cuida de gente, vem ser Gigante! Aqui, quem acredita e trabalha cresce.

Antes de sabermos mais sobre suas características profissionais, convidamos você a conhecer um pouco da história da Santa Casa da

Bahia, instituição filantrópica que se propõe ao objetivo de ajudar aos mais necessitados.

Foi no ano de 1549, quando Tomé de Sousa ocupava o posto de governador-geral do Brasil, que foi construída uma casa de taipa e palha, no Centro Histórico de Salvador, que por cerca de 200 anos abrigou o Hospital de Caridade, primeiro hospital do Estado da Bahia, sendo o único a prestar assistência aos baianos na época.

Somente em 30 de julho de 1893 foi construído o Hospital Santa Izabel (HSI), no bairro de Nazaré, em Salvador, desativando a antiga unidade de saúde que funcionava no Pelourinho. O prédio do primeiro hospital passou a ser a sede administrativa da Santa Casa da Bahia e, em 2006, se tornou o Museu da Misericórdia.

A Santa Casa da Bahia é uma associação beneficente de assistência social, que se propõe ao exercício da caridade e prestação de

serviços nas áreas de saúde, ensino, pesquisa, cultura, assistência social e educação, sem subordinação ao Estado ou à Igreja.
